NORTH PIER / OPERATOR MEMO
Recovered from the workstation's printed handover folder.

The records mirror was built for quick retrieval, not secure access control. The prototype stored the selected catalogue slot in the browser so that a page refresh could reopen the same record.

A reviewer previously warned that browser storage should not be treated as proof of authorisation. The warning was marked "to be fixed in next release", but no follow-up was recorded.
